subject.name_or_desc: ICC Cricket World Cup 2019 — the India team, captained by Virat Kohli (born 1988), with MS Dhoni in the squad

context.question: Will India win the 2019 Cricket World Cup?
context.setting: The tournament runs 30 May–14 July 2019 in England and Wales, in a ten-team round-robin format. India are regarded as one of the firm favourites. The astrologer has just released a book of cricket predictions at a launch event in Mumbai.
